title: Animated Heart
description: Animated Hearts adds smooth and customizable heart HUD effects
body:
❤️ Animated Hearts

Animated Hearts replaces the vanilla half-heart with a fully animated blinking heart, creating a smoother  
and more visually appealing health bar while preserving Minecraft's original look.

❌Before

![alt text](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Waa132/AnimatedHearts/main/old_vanill_hearts.png)

✨After

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Waa132/AnimatedHearts/main/vanill_hearts.gif)

Instead of displaying a static half-heart when you have half a heart of health, the mod renders a full heart with a subtle blinking animation. This makes your health bar feel more alive while staying faithful to the classic vanilla aesthetic.

## Features

*   ❤️ Replaces the vanilla half-heart with a fully animated blinking heart.
*   🎨 Preserves Minecraft's original style.
*   📦 Fully compatible with resource packs by using the game's own heart textures.
*   ⚙️ Highly configurable animation system with extensive customization options.
*   🌈 Supports multiple vanilla heart variants, including Poison, Wither, Hardcore, Absorption, Frozen Hearts, Fire, and other vanilla heart types.
*   🧩 Designed to work alongside most mods that use Minecraft's standard heart rendering.
*   💻 Lightweight client-side mod with minimal performance impact.

## Configuration

The configuration file allows you to customize:

*   Animation speed
*   Animation FPS
*   Animation smoothness
*   Transparency
*   Health threshold for displaying the animated heart
*   Various animation behavior options

## Future Plans

Animated Hearts is under active development. Future updates will expand animation support to **every vanilla heart type**, giving each effect its own unique animation while maintaining full compatibility with resource packs and the vanilla art style.

The long-term goal is to make every heart in Minecraft feel alive without sacrificing the familiar vanilla experience.
